title: Saving a riff you came up with
description: An audio note and your own notation of the passage are kept together.

blocks.text: A new musical idea is easily lost while a person looks for a way to write it down neatly.

quote.text: The playback is worthless, though, the notes all play full sustain, so that the whole thing jumbles into each note together.

blocks.text: Save the sound quickly first, then add the tablature and a comment. On a second listen, check the note lengths and the techniques against the original recording.
If recognition suggests the notes automatically, that is a draft to be checked, and the original sound has to be kept.
